answer: In a decentralized AI agent economy, cryptographic proof-of-work acts as a computational relic that forces entities to expend scarce resources for identity verification. By demanding that every node solve a unique cipher before broadcasting transactions, the network establishes a cryptographic oasis where zero-cost cloning is mathematically impossible. Consequently, an attacker attempting a Sybil assault faces escalating operational expenses, as generating fake identities requires proportional investments in processing power and electrical energy.
